# src_xlive

`xlive_shim.cpp` implements an offline Windows LIVE compatibility layer, while `xlive.def` preserves the exported `xlive` ABI and `README.md` documents storage and profile-import behavior.

## Contents

- [README.md](./README.md) documents `storage/profiles`, `title_storage`, `41560829.gpd`, deterministic XUID generation, and `name`-based profile selection.
- [xlive.def](./xlive.def) maps `xlive_X*` exports to fixed ordinals with `NONAME`.
- [xlive_shim.cpp](./xlive_shim.cpp) implements Winsock forwarding, offline identity, profile settings, title storage, session stubs, UI stubs, and overlapped operations.

## Architecture

`xlive_shim.cpp` resolves identity through `offline_name()` and `offline_xuid()`, persists settings through `storage_root()`, `offline_profile_root()`, and `profile_setting_path()`, and maps title-storage requests through `title_storage_path()`.

`xlive_XUserReadProfileSettings()` imports legacy `41560829.gpd` data through `import_legacy_qos_profile()`, serializes values through `serialize_profile_value()`, and returns packed `xuser_read_profile_setting_result` data.

`xlive_XStorageUploadFromMemory()` and `xlive_XStorageDownloadToMemory()` exchange binary payloads through `read_file()`, `write_file()`, and `title_storage_path()`.

`complete_overlapped()`, `finish_operation()`, `inert_success()`, and `inert_not_found()` coordinate `xoverlapped` completion, Win32 events, callbacks, and observable error codes.

## ABI Surface

`xlive.def` exports networking, XNet, notification, rendering, protected-data, UI, user, profile, statistics, session, and title-storage symbols with stable ordinals.

`xlive_XWSAStartup()`, `xlive_XSocketCreate()`, `xlive_XSocketClose()`, `xlive_XSocketIOCTLSocket()`, `xlive_XSocketSetSockOpt()`, `xlive_XSocketBind()`, `xlive_XSocketRecvFrom()`, `xlive_XSocketSendTo()`, `xlive_XSocketInet_Addr()`, `xlive_XWSAGetLastError()`, and `xlive_XSocketHTONS()` forward to Winsock.

`xlive_XUserGetXUID()`, `xlive_XUserGetName()`, `xlive_XUserGetSigninInfo()`, `xlive_XUserReadProfileSettings()`, and `xlive_XUserWriteProfileSettings()` implement deterministic offline user and profile behavior for user index `0`.

`xlive_XSessionCreate()`, `xlive_XSessionDelete()`, `xlive_XSessionMigrateHost()`, and related `xlive_XSession*()` functions create, update, and complete offline session operations.

`xlive_XStorageBuildServerPath()`, `xlive_XStorageUploadFromMemory()`, and `xlive_XStorageDownloadToMemory()` implement the `offline://<facility>/<sanitized-item>` title-storage contract.

## Behavioral Contracts

- `offline_xuid()` uses FNV-1a constants `1469598103934665603ull` and `1099511628211ull`, then applies the GFWL-style `0xE000000000000000ull | (hash & 0x0000FFFFFFFFFFFFull)` range.
- `offline_name()` checks the `name` dvar, command-line `name`, `+name`, `-name`, `-set name value`, and `-seta name value`, then falls back to `"Player"`.
- `qos_module()` uses `qos_base = 0x10000000`, `dvar_hash_table_addr = 0x1149FCE0`, and `generate_hash_value_addr = 0x10275260`.
- `title_storage_path()` strips case-insensitive `offline://`, splits the first `/`, defaults facility to `"3"`, and calls `sanitize_storage_name()`.
- `sanitize_storage_name()` replaces control characters and `<>:"/\\|?*` with `_`, and maps empty, `"."`, and `".."` to `"unnamed"`.
- `import_legacy_qos_profile()` validates little-endian `FBDX`/XDBF tables and imports namespace-3 settings only when destination files are absent.
- `xlive_XStorageDownloadToMemory()` returns `0x8015C004` for missing files, `0x8015C003` for oversized files, and copies `bytes_total`, `xuid_owner`, and `created` metadata.
- `xlive_XUserReadProfileSettings()` returns `ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER` with the required size, emits null settings for missing files, and supports `xuser_data` tags `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `5`, `6`, `7`, and `0xFF`.
- `xlive_XEnumerate()`, `xlive_XUserCreateStatsEnumeratorByRank()`, `xlive_XUserCreateStatsEnumeratorByXuid()`, and `xlive_XFriendsCreateEnumerator()` use `ERROR_NO_MORE_FILES` for empty enumerations.
- `xlive_XNotifyGetNext()` returns `FALSE`, `xlive_XNetGetConnectStatus()` returns connected state `2`, `xlive_XNetGetTitleXnAddr()` returns a local ready address, `xlive_XOnlineGetNatType()` returns open NAT state `1`, and `xlive_XNetGetEthernetLinkStatus()` returns active state `1`.

## Integration Constraints

`xlive.def` ordinal stability and `NONAME` declarations are ABI-critical for consumers of `xlive`.

`xlive_shim.cpp` requires Windows headers, Winsock2, `shellapi`, filesystem support, and 64-bit-compatible layouts for `XUID`, `xoverlapped`, `xsession_info`, `xstorage_download_results`, `xuser_data`, `xuser_profile_setting`, `xuser_read_profile_setting_result`, and `xuser_signin_info`.

`xlive_XUserWriteProfileSettings()` always writes under `qos_title_id = 0x41560829`, while `xlive_XUserReadProfileSettings()` uses `qos_title_id` only when `title_id == 0`.

`xlive_XSessionCreate()` owns event handles consumed by `xlive_XSessionDelete()`, and `xlive_XNotifyCreateListener()` creates an auto-reset event requiring lifecycle cleanup.

`xoverlapped` operations complete immediately, but APIs with an `xoverlapped` argument may return `ERROR_IO_PENDING`; callers should inspect `xlive_XGetOverlappedResult()` or `xlive_XGetOverlappedExtendedError()`.
